verdict.rationale: Anytype's local API and MCP server require a key minted in the desktop app (anytype-probe-rt-1, anytype-docs-1), but nothing in the evidence describes scopes, permission levels, or least-privilege credential issuance for agents — the API/OpenAPI spec is just a flat set of endpoints (anytype-probe-rt-2) with no mention of restricting an agent's key to specific actions or Objects. missing for 10: any documentation of scoped/role-based API keys, per-agent permission restriction, or revocation/least-privilege credential model.
